question: The Regulating Act of 1773 provided that a Supreme Court would be established in Calcutta, consisting of a Chief Justice and _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three additional judges**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Regulating Act of 1773** was an important piece of legislation passed by the British Parliament to address administrative and governance issues in British India.
 
• It was the first step towards centralizing the administration of British territories in India under the control of the British Parliament.
 
• One of the provisions of the Act included the establishment of a **Supreme Court in Calcutta** to administer justice. This was to ensure a structured judicial system in British India.
 
• The **Supreme Court** was to consist of a Chief Justice and **three additional judges**. This provision aimed to create a fair and transparent judiciary in Calcutta.
 
• This court had jurisdiction over British subjects in Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa and was established in **1774**.
